# Green Lantern: 10 Essential John Stewart Comics
John Stewart Green Lantern - DC Comics

3

By  Jared Gaudreau

Published Jan 12, 2022, 12:30 PM EST
The fourth human Green Lantern introduced in the Green Lantern mythos was the former marine and architect John Stewart. As one of eight human Green Lanterns in the corps, John Stewart, despite his popularity in the *Justice League Unlimited* show, has often found himself taking the backseat to other Lanterns like Hal Jordan and Kyle Rayner. However, John has remained one of the most popular members of the Green Lantern mythos.

RELATED: Green Lantern: 10 Things You Should Know About John Stewart
Once readers dig past the comics' surface level, it's clear that many great stories featuring John Stewart do exist, from compelling solo stories to adventures as one of the four corpsmen. Thanks to well-executed themes like regret, pride, fellowship, and justice, John Stewart has a great collection of comic storylines despite never having a proper solo run.
## 10 John Stewart's Debut
John Stewart Debut DC Comics

John Stewart made his comic debut in *Green Lantern* Vol 2 #87 as the backup Green Lantern to Hal Jordan after his original backup, Guy Gardner, was hurt during an earthquake. In the issue, Hal consults with one of the Guardians of the Universe as they look down from a rooftop at two kids playing cards on the street. As a cop walks up, harassing the two kids, John Stewart quickly approaches and defends the kids using his signature feisty attitude.
John's philosophy and unorthodox methods initially make Hal think that John is not fit for the Green Lantern Corps. Still, after the two work together to protect a US senator, Hal realizes that John's unusual style is not a problem but an asset.
## 9 John Stewart Joins The Justice League
John Stewart Green Lantern DC

In his 2nd appearance in DC Comics, *Justice League of America* #110, John Stewart made his Justice League debut. Thanks to Hal slipping in the shower and knocking himself unconscious, John Stewart is called into action to work alongside the Justice League to defeat The Key – a maniacal villain who's working to ruin Christmas for an orphanage full of kids.
RELATED: DC: Ranking The Top 10 Members Of The Justice League By Personality

This issue made readers realize the kind of hero John Stewart is, and it also made long-time Justice League member, Green Arrow, officially recognize John as a worthy replacement for his friend, Hal Jordan.
## 8 John Fights Major Disaster
At this point in Green Lantern history, Hal Jordan had completely given up the responsibilities of the Green Lantern of sector 2814, leaving the Guardians to fill the role with John Stewart. In *Green Lantern*  Vol 2 #182, as John and Hal sit in a bar and share a drink, the TV comes on and reveals that Major Disaster – a former foe of Hal's – has invaded Coast City and is attempting to draw out his former nemesis for a rematch.
The two separate with John leaving the bar in a hurry as Hal heads for the phone, hoping to contact any of his hero friends. Hal turns to look out of the window and sees John fly into the sky towards Major Disaster. At that moment, Hal Jordan realized that the Guardians had replaced him with his friend, John Stewart.
## 6 John Visits Fatality In Prison
Green Lantern DC Comics

After John accidentally destroyed Xanshi, he spent years hating himself and the mistake he made, and even attempted suicide. If it weren't for his confrontations with Xanshi's only survivor, Yrra Cynril, aka Fatality, John would never have been able to forgive himself.
In *Green Lantern* Vol 3 #156, after stopping a ring of illegal smuggling, John Stewart, alongside the original Green Lantern, Alan Scott, stops an armed robbery in New York City. After getting some advice from Alan, John heads to the Slab – a high-security prison – where he thanks Fatality for helping him move on from his mistakes. Fatality is not moved by the words and tells John Stewart that she will kill him and everyone he's ever loved.
## 5 John Stewart Sees His Wife Again
John Stewart Green Lantern DC Comics

DC's Blackest Night event pitted the Green Lantern Corps against Nekron – the force of death who reanimated dead heroes to eliminate all living things from the universe. In *Green Lantern* Vol 4 #49, John goes up against an army of Black Lanterns, including his late wife, Katma Tui.
As emotions confront John, Katma, charged by Nekron, tells John the Black Lantern Corps is greater than him because it could do what he couldn't: save the victims of Xanshi.
RELATED: The 10 Deadliest Members Of The Black Lantern Corps Ranked

John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns. This encounter with Katma made John think about his advice and how being a Green Lantern doesn't build character; it reveals it.
## 4 John Stewart Kills Mogo
John Kyle Green Lantern

In a tremendous team-up story, John Stewart, now a member of the Indigo Tribe, and Kyle Rayner, a Blue Lantern at the time, discovered Mogo the Living Planet corrupted by Black Lantern energy. In *Green Lantern Corps* Vol 2 #60, Kyle and John come across Mogo as hundreds of Green Lantern power rings are being expelled from his core.
Realizing a problem, the two enter Mogo's core to find that he's filled with Black Lantern energy, making all his expelling rings corrupted as well. After Kyle's ring cannot purify Mogo, John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.
## 3 The Alpha Lanterns Arrest John Stewart
John Stewart Green Lantern DC Comics

The murder of Kirrt, a member of the Green Lantern Corps, is one of the most challenging things John Stewart has had to do in his years as a Green Lantern. In *Green Lantern Corps* Vol 3 #6, John, Vandor, and Kirrt are tortured by the Keepers. Giving in to the torture, Kirrt decides to give the Keepers what they want: information on how to break Oa's security shield.
RELATED: 10 Most Creative Green Lantern Constructs, Ranked

Before he can hand over the data, John breaks his neck, killing Kirrt while simultaneously saving thousands of Green Lanterns. Later in the storyline, in *Green Lantern Corps* Vol 3 #9, John, despite protests by Guy Gardner, is arrested by the Alpha Lanterns for the murder of Kirrt.
## 2 John Stewart's New Origin
Secret Origin

A standard method by DC to retcon character origins is to give them a story in *DC Secret Origins*. John Stewart received his edition of the title in *DC Secret Origins* Vol 3 #9. In the issue, John is introduced as a young man in Detroit participating in protests with his mom. After life in the marine corps, John is contracted by Ferris Air to design a building on their property.
## 1 John Stewart's Rematch With The Shayol
JL Adventures 22

The *Justice League Unlimited* animated series has played a considerable role in the popularity of John Stewart. Its comic counterpart, *Justice League Adventures*, continues the same storyline that made John a fan-favorite member of the Justice League. In *Justice League Adventures* #22, John remembers a past mission where three of his Green Lantern Corps allies are killed at the hands of Shayol.
